scientific_intent.scientific_task: Cluster Euclidean points with a diameter threshold using greedy complete-link candidates from every remaining seed.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: For each remaining seed, repeatedly add the point minimizing maximum distance to the candidate, breaking ties by point ID. Choose the candidate with greatest cardinality, retaining earliest active seed on ties; remove its members and repeat. Stop after a cardinality-one cluster as the source does, retaining the actual residual list.
scientific_intent.discretization: Three exact dyadic 1D point clouds embedded in the source 2D domain:192 points in cliques67/65/60,128 points spaced by0.25, and65 points containing a duplicate pair and63 isolated points. Sorted compact nonself neighbor graph uses strict Euclidean distance<1.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Exact complete per-iteration seed/cardinality/ordered members/remaining active list/clustered masks/degrees versus an independent full-coordinate complete-link oracle. Full raw GPU workspaces compare exactly with both references; actual input bits and all guards exact. No NaN accepted.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: Named small single-GPU clouds with37 total convergence iterations and explicit singleton-stop control; not original random4096-point CLI or distributed MPI.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: All distances and threshold margins are exact dyadic Float32 values; Float32 caches/threshold, Int32 indices/cards, Int8 masks. No threshold ambiguity or arbitrary tolerance. Julia host/device address indexing uses Int64 while stored graph indices remain Int32.

scientific_intent.description: Historical Julia marked an array and fabricated convergence/timing statistics. The current study restores all five source device kernels and complete source convergence for named geometric fixtures; source singleton residual behavior is retained explicitly.
scientific_intent.provenance: Native QTC.cu and compact/common kernel headers; source benchmark comments identify Anthony Danalis and2011 creation. No additional paper or application provenance inferred.
